tips.text: Run the Narmer bounties from Eudico in Fortuna; the tables match Konzu's, but Vallis objectives stay near the gate.
Finish every bonus objective; each stage's Isoplast comes from that stage's roll.
Budget your runs around Isoplast, not parts, and take a few bounties a day; the parts finish well before the Isoplast does.
Bring Volt, Nova or Wisp for the drone-escort stage; it is the slowest objective and a speed buff cuts a bounty to 7 or 8 minutes.
When the board is on a part you already own, spend that cycle fishing, mining Hesperon or running the Murex node.
On Cetus, leave Chesa and other disarm abilities at home; disarming the Narmer captain before every Vomvalyst dies makes him unkillable.
Players often name Caliban one of the worst base-frame farms, because Isoplast is thin and nothing pities bad luck.
Expect about 15 to 20 full bounties plus the side materials; some players need weeks of on-and-off play.
